description: Process tender attachments in E2B: sends documents and business context to E2B, PDF page images/images and extracted evidence to Cohere Parse and Command A+. See /privacy for processing locations. Returns within 145 seconds including setup; large packages may time out. Retry with fewer attachments; a timeout is not a completed analysis. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required.

apc_document_urls.description: For APC only: map document IDs from get_opportunity_details to already authorized, publicly accessible HTTPS copies. This tool never signs in to APC, registers supplier interest, subscribes notifications, or accepts authenticated download URLs. Copies are sent to E2B and their contents to Cohere.

business_context.description: Optional company capabilities or bid context. If omitted, the saved business profile is used.

max_attachments.description: Maximum procurement files to process (default 5, max 5). Use 0 explicitly for a notice-only review; missing/gated documents do not count as complete coverage.

profile.description: Inline business profile used for this call only. Overrides any saved profile. On the shared public endpoint without a subscriber key, this is the way to describe your business.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit capability keywords; derived from description when omitted

description.description: What the business does: products, services, capabilities

industries.description: Optional industries such as steel, lumber, aluminum, construction

location.description: Where the business is located, e.g. 'Edmonton, Alberta'

reference.description: CanadaBuys or Alberta APC reference number

name: process_bid_room
